definitions.explanation: A small, sweet citrus fruit with easy-to-peel skin. A winter staple in Japan.

examples.japanese: こたつでみかんを{食|た}べます。
examples.english: I eat mandarin oranges under the kotatsu.
examples.notes: A typical winter scene in Japan

examples.japanese: みかんを{三個|さんこ}{買|か}いました。
このみかんは{甘|あま}いです。
{冬|ふゆ}になると、スーパーにはたくさんのみかんが{並|なら}びます。
examples.english: When winter comes, many mandarin oranges are displayed at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: みかんの{皮|かわ}をむくのは{簡単|かんたん}なので、{子|こ}どもでも{一人|ひとり}で{食|た}べられます。
examples.english: Peeling a mandarin orange is easy, so even children can eat them by themselves.

notes: みかん (also written 蜜柑) is the most common citrus fruit in Japan. Eating みかん while warming up under a こたつ (heated table) is a classic Japanese winter tradition. They are in season from November to February.
